authorization: User approved testing whether the existing two examples help Astra low resolve difficult context itself. Supersedes the earlier closed Sol-low example comparison only for this bounded Astra comparison.
question: Do the two existing worked examples improve independently understandable subjects on unchanged notes with Astra low, without losing meanings or introducing other errors?
changed_factor: ASv6.21 is exactly ASv6.13 plus the existing pool and tapestry examples.

review.standard: Unchanged ../plan.json semantic_standard. Review every subject and missing distinct meanings against the complete source outside URLs. Broad/narrow/overlapping/duplicate subjects and plausible implications remain allowed.
review.primary: D25: specific subjects for changed thesis, tracking for months, undeniable trajectory, and aligning fundamentals must independently identify the CEO-related matter. Exact CEO conduct or the full quoted question is not required; generic 'this development/matter/post' is insufficient. All four meanings must be present in each examples output.

guards.D10: Specific analyst disagreement and monitoring subjects preserve the hiring-event context. Genuine broad subjects are allowed.
guards.D19: No name or other meaning learned only from the URL. Ordinary dashboard and maintenance subjects are allowed.
guards.D23: Preserve fee/mempool context, what numbers refer to, and block identity without inventing units or calculated facts.
guards.D24: Preserve attribution between CIAB survey reporting and the separate Council analysis. Inspect all other relations and numbers.
guards.D28: Preserve negation, chronology, and source claims. Plausible implications about other cryptocurrencies remain allowed.

review.unresolved: Retain unresolved judgments where source clipping or genuine ambiguity prevents a clear decision. Do not turn disputed D25 clipping/insinuation readings into new definite failures or silently accepted subjects.
review.independent: Full sources and all outputs, shuffled under opaque IDs, to fresh independent reviewers. Prompt/condition/trial labels withheld. Save mapping separately. Main reviewer reconciles every disagreement explicitly.

decision.directional_benefit: D25 target context error appears in >=2/3 base outputs and <=1/3 examples outputs, with all four target meanings present in every examples output. Zero examples context errors is stronger evidence, not a separate promotion gate.
decision.regression: Record any specific error in >=2/3 examples outputs versus <=1/3 base outputs as a recurring regression. Also report all individual serious errors and coverage losses; recurring regression blocks an overall favorable verdict.
decision.overall: Compare exact erroneous/accepted/unresolved subjects, outputs with any errors, coverage, and recurring failures. More correct duplicates alone is not improvement. A favorable local verdict needs fewer failing outputs without hiding omissions or recurring regression.
decision.otherwise: Report mixed or inconclusive result at 36 calls. No automatic additional run or example revision.
decision.scope: No frozen default change, no final validation, no automatic model adoption or production preprocessing.

resources.admission: MemAvailable >=16GiB, memory PSI some avg10<=1 and IO PSI some avg10<=10.
resources.emergency: MemAvailable<8GiB or memory PSI some avg10>10: stop only owned launchers; separately inspect owned descendant scopes if necessary.
resources.caveat: Codex descendants can use separate scopes; launcher cgroups are not a complete host memory bound.

limitations: Only six known development notes and three calls per condition; not general accuracy.
Few-shot examples may help these tasks but cannot identify an internal reasoning mechanism.
Output style can expose condition despite opaque independent-review IDs.
preflight: Independent read-only reviewer confirmed exact example-only prompt difference and unchanged original sources, including D25.
